rootPassive.name: Featherfall
rootPassive.text: No fall damage from any height. Gliders cost half the stamina, and a glider that closes low never hurts you.

trunk.name: Gust
trunk.text: Basic wind spell: a blast that throws enemies back in a cone. In the air it throws you the other way too

trunk.name: Off balance
trunk.text: Wind hits and slams into walls break more stance

trunk.name: Wind cut
trunk.text: Basic wind weapon art: a slash that sends a blade of wind ahead and knocks back what it meets

nodes.name: Glide
nodes.text: Jump again in the air to glide from any height with no glider, on Momentum

nodes.name: Air dash
nodes.text: Spell: dash through the air, untouchable for the dash; once each time you leave the ground

nodes.name: Plunge
nodes.text: Weapon art from the air: dive blade-first and burst the ground where you land; the higher, the harder

nodes.name: Lift
nodes.text: Jump higher; at rank 3, a second small jump in the air

nodes.name: Aerial mastery
nodes.text: More damage while you're in the air

nodes.name: Sky lord
nodes.text: rise and hover for a while, every attack coming from the air

nodes.name: Whirlwind
nodes.text: Weapon art for great weapons and axes: spin, hitting everything round you; hold to keep spinning

nodes.name: Vortex
nodes.text: Spell: pull enemies in from all round you, into your spin if you're spinning

nodes.name: Eye of the storm
nodes.text: Take less damage while you spin

nodes.name: Debris
nodes.text: Each spin throws stones out round you

nodes.name: Lingering gale
nodes.text: Your spins leave a gale on the ground that hurts and holds small creatures off

nodes.name: Tornado
nodes.text: a tornado you steer that lifts small creatures and drags bigger ones in

nodes.name: Wind arrow
nodes.text: Weapon art for bows and crossbows: a shot on the wind that knocks back and goes through a body

nodes.name: Piercing gale
nodes.text: Your arrows, bolts and thrown weapons go through one more body

nodes.name: Tailwind shot
nodes.text: Aimed shots push you back a step (further in the air); hold Sprint as you shoot to stand fast

nodes.name: Storm volley
nodes.text: loose into the sky and rain thirty arrows where you aim
